Python reference

Source: vignettes/articles/python-reference.Rmd
python-reference.Rmd

The Python package’s classes, functions and values, under the sections of the R reference and in its order. import resolve_core as rc reaches every name below. Predicting plot attributes from species lists runs them on the survey that ships with the R package.

Installation 

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("gcol33/resolve/r")

# The engine library, downloaded once
library(resolveR)
resolve.install_backend()
pip install resolve-core

Loading data

Plots and the species records observed in them, from CSV files or data frames, into an engine dataset.

RoleMapping
Names the columns of the two tables by the part they play in a dataset.
TargetSpec
One target, a plot-table column the model learns to predict, and how its values are read.
TaskType
The kind of a target: regression or classification.
TransformType
The transform a regression target is stored under.
TargetMissingPolicy
What a plot with no value for a target does.
DatasetConfig
How the species recorded on a plot become model input.
SpeciesEncodingMode
The encoding of a plot’s species set.
SelectionMode
Which species of a plot fill its budget.
RepresentationMode
The value a species carries into the encoding: its abundance, or 1.
NormalizationMode
How the hash weights of a plot’s selected species are rescaled.
AggregationMode
How genera and families are ranked and weighted.
PoolWeighting
The weight a species pools with under the rank-pool and transformer encodings.
MissingValuePolicy
How a blank covariate or coordinate cell enters the model.
effective_selection()
The species selection a dataset loaded under a configuration applies.
ResolveDataset
The loaded and encoded plots, and the loaders that build them.
ResolveSchema
The structure of a loaded dataset: the input widths, the targets and the vocabularies.
TargetConfig
A target as the dataset loaded it.
ExternalVocabs
Every vocabulary a dataset fitted, in the form the loaders that reuse vocabularies take.
external_vocabs_from_schema()
The vocabularies a schema carries.
EncodingVocab
The species and taxonomy vocabularies one encoding codes a plot with.
SpeciesVocab
Each species name to an integer code, 0 for an unknown species.
TaxonomyVocab
Each genus and family name to an integer code.
CategoricalVocab
The integer codes of each categorical column.
SpeciesRecord
One species recorded on one plot.
EmbeddingEncoder
The embed encoding on its own, outside a dataset.
EmbeddingEncodedData
The species and taxonomy slots EmbeddingEncoder returns.
RankPoolEncoder
The rank-pool encoding on its own, outside a dataset.
RankPoolEncodedData
The pooled species, weights and mask RankPoolEncoder returns.
build_species_graph()
The graph over the species vocabulary a heterogeneous GNN passes messages on.
SpeciesGraph
The edges of a species graph and their types.
SpeciesEdgeType
The kind of a species-graph edge: same genus, same family or co-occurrence.

Training

Fitting a model, cross-validating it and pretraining its encoder without labels.

ResolveModel
The network: a species encoder, a shared encoder and one output head per target.
ModelForwardResult
A forward pass’s outputs with its auxiliary loss terms.
model_config_for_dataset()
A model configuration with the fields that size a model taken from its dataset.
ModelConfig
The architecture of a model.
FTTransformerConfig
The settings of the FT-Transformer architecture.
TabNetConfig
The settings of the TabNet architecture.
SAINTConfig
The settings of the SAINT architecture.
ExcelFormerConfig
The settings of the ExcelFormer architecture.
GNNConfig
The settings of the graph neural network over plots.
HeterogeneousGNNConfig
The settings of the graph neural network over species.
TraitNetConfig
The settings of the TraitNet architecture.
TabMConfig
TabM as the encoder’s final stage.
ParallelLayersConfig
A block of parallel branches as the encoder’s final stage.
ParallelBranchConfig
One branch of a parallel block.
Trainer
Fits a model: the split, the training loop, cross-validation, the held-out evaluations and checkpoints.
TrainConfig
The settings of a training run.
TrainResult
The metrics, loss histories and baselines a fit returns.
BaselineMetrics
A target’s naive baseline beside the model.
CrossValidationResult
The metrics of a cross-validation, per fold and across folds.
SpatialBlockConfig
The latitude and longitude blocks of a spatial cross-validation.
ResidualAnalysis
The residuals of a regression target on the held-out fold.
ClassificationPredictions
The class predictions and probabilities of a classification target on the held-out fold.
CalibrationResult
How well a classifier’s probabilities match how often it is right.
CalibrationBin
One bin of predicted probability.
NetworkDiagnostics
The activations of the species encoder’s hidden layers.
LayerDiagnostics
The activations of one hidden layer.
PretrainConfig
The settings of JEPA and SCARF pretraining.
JEPAPretrainer
Pretrains an encoder by predicting the latent of a plot from a masked view of it.
SCARFPretrainer
Pretrains an encoder by matching each plot with a corrupted copy of it.
PretrainResult
The loss history of a pretraining run.
MaskStrategy
Which features JEPA masks.
MLMPretrainConfig
The settings of masked-species pretraining.
MaskedSpeciesPretrainer
Pretrains a transformer species encoder by naming the species hidden from it.
VAEConfig
The settings of the variational autoencoder.
VAEPretrainer
A variational autoencoder of the plots’ species vectors.
VAEPretrainResult
The loss histories of a variational autoencoder run.
LossConfigMode
The regression loss.
LRSchedulerType
How the learning rate changes over a run.
SelectionMetric
The held-out value a run selects its epoch by.
ActivationType
The activation functions.
NormLayerType
The normalisation layers.
EncoderArchitecture
The architecture of the shared encoder.
MoERoutingType
How a mixture of experts routes a plot.
MoEPlacement
Where the mixture of experts sits in the encoder.
GNNType
The graph layer of the graph neural network over plots.
GraphConstructionMode
What the plot graph measures neighbourhood on.
TraitInteractionMode
How TraitNet combines the environment and a species’ traits.
TabMAggregation
How TabM combines its ensemble.
TransformerPooling
How the transformer encoding pools its species tokens.
ParallelAggregation
How a parallel block combines its branches.

Saving and predicting

Checkpoints, what they record about the run, and predictions for new plots.

Predictor
Predictions, latent representations and embedding tables from a trained model.
ResolvePredictions
The predictions and class probabilities for every plot.
RetrievalConfig
The settings of retrieval augmentation.
nearest_by_cosine()
The rows of a reference set most similar to each query row by cosine similarity.
Scalers
The input and target scaling fitted on the training plots.
RunMetadata
The run as a checkpoint records it: split, timing, epochs and final metrics.
HoldOutMode
How a run’s held-out fold was drawn.
dataset_config_from_checkpoint()
The loader settings a checkpoint was trained under.
target_specs_from_schema()
The targets a checkpoint was trained on.

Model suites

Several trained models released as one directory and scored together.

SuiteManifest
A suite’s manifest: the input contract, the targets, their members and the provenance.
SuiteInputContract
The columns a suite reads and how their values are read.
SuiteTarget
One released target of a suite.
SuiteTargetInputs
The part of the input contract a target’s members read.
SuiteMember
One checkpoint of a suite target.
SuiteCombine
How a suite target combines its members.
SuiteTargetStatus
Released or experimental.
SuitePredictor
A suite loaded from its directory, scored as one model.
SuiteColumns
Renames the manifest’s input columns at prediction time.
SuitePredictions
Every target’s predictions, and the table they are written as.
SuiteTargetPrediction
One target’s combined prediction, the members’ agreement or spread, and the species recognition.
suite_prediction_columns()
The predictions as named columns, one value per plot.
CombinedPrediction
A combined prediction with its agreement or dispersion.
combine_vote()
The class most members predict.
combine_mean()
The members’ mean and standard deviation.
combine_circular()
The members’ circular mean and circular standard deviation.
combine_spherical()
The members’ mean point on the sphere and their spread in km.
bearing_from_components()
A bearing from its sine and cosine.
EARTH_RADIUS_KM
The Earth radius the spherical mean measures distances with.
sha256_file()
The SHA-256 digest of a file.

Gap fitting

Filling a dataset’s missing values from its own complete plots, beside the raw prediction.

fit_gaps()
One target’s gaps from the raw prediction, the recorded values and the plots’ composition, positions and years.
fit_prediction_gaps()
A single model’s gaps from its predictions and the dataset’s tables.
read_gap_tables()
What gap fitting reads about a dataset’s plots, from DataFrames or CSV paths.
GapFittingConfig
The candidates, the neighbour counts, spatial neighbours on or off and the matching seed.
GapTarget
A target’s name, scale and period.
GapScale
How a target’s values lie: linear, log, circular or geographic.
GapMethod
The methods a gap can be predicted by.
GapFit
The fitted values, the method per plot and the report.
matched_gap_neighbours()
The neighbours the choice is tested with.
GapColumns, GapTables, GapFitRequest
The low-level columns, tables and requests the functions above build.

Terrain correction

Altitude and slope combined with an elevation model read at the plots, and the elevation model a suite ships.

TerrainGrids, open_terrain_field(), TerrainCodedField, TerrainField
Elevation grids on disk and terrain field files, as sources of elevations.
terrain_descriptors()
The elevation, the 1 km mean, the slope and the 1 km inclination at coordinates.
encode_terrain_grids()
Elevation grids coded into a terrain field with a bounded error per cell.
fit_terrain_tile(), assemble_terrain_field()
The neural terrain field format, tile by tile.
fit_terrain_correction()
The gated correction of one target, fitted on plots with recorded values.
TerrainCorrection
A fitted correction: apply, save, load.
nearest_by_great_circle()
The nearest rows of a reference set by great-circle distance.

Species names

Species names read as the names a model learnt.

resolve_names()
Resolve species names against a model’s vocabulary, with the route each takes.
NameTable
The release’s name table: entered names and synonyms with the token each stands for.
SpeciesNames
How a load or a suite prediction resolves species names.
NameResolver
Resolves names against one vocabulary.
ResolvedName
What the resolver gives for one name.
NameRoute
Exact, alias, spelling or unresolved.
SpeciesNameReport
The names a load or a suite target did not find as written.

Scoring

The metrics training reports, for predictions made anywhere.

Metrics
The regression and classification metrics as functions of two tensors.
ClassificationMetrics
Accuracy, F1 scores and the confusion matrix of a classification.
ConfidenceMetrics
The accuracy and coverage of the predictions above a confidence threshold.
compute_species_recognition()
How much of each plot’s species list a vocabulary recognises.
SpeciesRecognition
The recognised species of each plot, by count and by abundance.
compute_unknown_species_stats()
The unknown-species columns of each plot against a vocabulary.
UnknownSpeciesStats
Each plot’s unknown share of abundance and number of unknown species.

The engine

The engine loaded, its memory and thread settings, its errors, and the index that matches names within a few edits.

__version__
The version of the engine loaded.
set_vram_fraction()
Caps the share of GPU memory the engine may use.
configure_cuda_allocator()
Sets the CUDA allocator’s configuration to the engine’s default.
default_cuda_alloc_conf()
The engine’s default CUDA allocator configuration.
set_thread_pools()
Sets the number of threads libtorch uses.
install_crash_handler()
Makes a native fault end the process at once on Windows.
StorageError
The exception for a file the engine cannot read or write.
fuzzy
The submodule of the name index.
fuzzy.FuzzyIndex
An index that returns the entries within a few edits of a query.
fuzzy.Match
One match a query returns.
